_comment: Shop-panel canonical (PROMOTED into the sweep, playtest fix wave 2026-08-04 -- it was a peek-style orphan while the exact surface it watches shipped a player trap). Loads the d2_shop fixture (Warrior L1 beside Krshia, purse = 5 gold) via title Continue. Proves BOTH halves of the shop UX in one run: (A) at 5 gold the cheapest buy (traveler_charm, 5) is affordable/ungreyed while the 15/18/24 options are greyed -- screenshot 01; (B) buy the charm (Paid 5 gold + Got item), purse -> 0; (C) re-open the stall now broke -> ALL four buy options greyed -- screenshot 03 (the greyed-while-broke proof). (D) 'Show me the charms.' opens the new 'charms' node holding the 6 new accessories/tools -- screenshot 04 (the grown panel + the new Resonance N card lines, all broke-greyed). Windowed so the greyed dialogue options are visually inspectable.

steps._comment: Playtest fix wave (findings 11/13): the whole script runs at the 130% accessibility step because THAT is where the trap lived -- at fs14 every shop node fits under the 684 cap (max 562), at 130% the stall and charms nodes genuinely overflow and the panel must cap + scroll. The user's report ('huge panel, no way out, had to kill the process') was the 130% case.
First talk this waking = Krshia's rotating pool line; a second interact opens the real krshia_crate graph.

steps._comment: Playtest fix wave (findings 11/13): THE TRAP PIN, at the 130% step. Before the fix the panel grew unbounded (autowrap rows measured at width 0 inflated `needed`, and non-picker dialogue had NO height cap), pushing its own exit row off-screen -- the only way out was killing the process. The fit now measures rows by font metrics at the real width and caps at 684 with a scrolling options region. 585 is the stall node's HONEST height at 130%; any regression in the measurement or the cap moves this number.
Buy the charm (visible index 0, unlocked at 5 gold): the buy contract fires effects [{gold:-5},{item:traveler_charm}] behind the requires:{gold:5} gate -> Paid 5 gold + Got the charm, purse -> 0.
